title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'Ask whether the company is mission-driven. Then ask how they know'
summary: A direct-to-camera piece aimed at people interviewing for jobs rather than at founders: two questions to put to an employer, where the second does the work. Eric's argument is that the follow-up forces a company to point at something written down — a charter commitment — instead of restating its values, and that the question gets harder to deflect the more candidates ask it. The clip drew replies on X working through the same point, with Kevin Payne noting that asking how they know 'forces a charter clause or a past decision, not a values poster.'
blockquote: Ask whether the company is mission-driven. Then ask how they know.
